answer: Random peer audit blocks bulk forgery. At dawn each epoch, 3 random auditors check every identity, unpredictable to a forger. Each auditor replays one recent job; failure freezes the identity and burns its $25 bond, a pass returns it. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x $25 = $25,000, more than fake votes could steal. An honest agent pays one $25 bond, keeps a pearl-clean record, and earns undiluted rewards; fakes fade like a comet.
